plain: To drive or push someone to act.

webster.text: To drive or urge forward; to press on; to excite to action or to move forward, by the application of physical force, or moral suasion or necessity.

example.quote: Their ambition and avarice most powerfully impel them to prevent our becoming a naval nation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
